component.name: Turing Smart Screen
component.summary: Configure and monitor USB smart screens on Linux

description.p: Turing Smart Screen is a Linux-focused GTK application for configuring, monitoring and managing compatible Turing, TURZX and related USB smart screens.
The application includes a GTK4/Libadwaita shell, theme gallery and editor, media preparation with FFmpeg, and experimental Rev. C native video and storage workflows.
This Flatpak is an experimental development release. Hardware access requires device permissions in the Flatpak sandbox and host-side udev rules supplied with the release.
First Flatpak packaging preview for the Linux GTK application.
